hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Reset the count "turnInPhase2".
Call arg.

Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Count up "turnInPhase2".
If the count "turnInPhase2" is more than the numeric entry "turns_of_staying_on_phase_2" in aiArg and the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in aiArg, then choose state 13 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).

flow.text: Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
the count "turnInPhase2" is more than the numeric entry "turns_of_staying_on_phase_2" in aiArg and the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in aiArg
the enemy is ready to act
